battle.verdict: Descript is the clear winner for podcasters, offering unlimited AI voices and a revolutionary text-based editing workflow. Murf is still great for high-quality voiceovers.

narration.text: Descript offers unlimited AI voices, Murf charges per minute!

First up, AI Voice Pricing! Descript includes unlimited AI voice generation in its creator plans. Murf, however, charges per minute for its premium AI voices, often as an add-on. That one hurts! Descript takes the round!

Next, Editing Workflow! Descript lets you edit audio by editing its transcript. It is like editing a document! Murf uses a more traditional timeline editor, which means more precise audio work but a steeper learning curve. No contest here! Descript wins again!
Descript is the champion for podcasters, with its unlimited AI voices and revolutionary text-based editing. Murf is still fantastic for polished voiceovers! Which tool would you pick?
